canon.note: Argenti is an Erudition Physical character (Energy limit 180). His Ultimate is usable at HALF Max Energy (90). Basic 130801 X Bière / Fleeting Fragrance (Physical single). Skill 130802 Thorns No Shelter for the Righteouously Obsolete: Physical AoE. Ultimate 130803 For In This Garden, Supreme Beauty Bestows at 90 Energy (Physical AoE); at full 180 Energy it becomes The Beautification in 'My' Garden (stronger AoE + 6 extra random hits). Talent 130804 Sublime Object: every enemy hit restores 3 Energy and grants 1 Apotheosis stack (max 10; 12 at E4); Trace Piety grants another stack at turn start, each stack = +1% CRIT Rate.

requirements.claim: Argenti opens at half Energy (90), so the standard Ultimate resolves before his first Skill.
Argenti's Energy never exceeds the 180 max (he ults at 90 - half of it).
E4 Trumpet's Dedication lets the Apotheosis stack cap grow to 12 (Apotheosis buff still applies).
